records.title: Poisson's ratio for anisotropic elastic materials can have no bounds
claim_notes: The Quarterly Journal of Mechanics and Applied Mathematics 58(1) (2005), pp. 73-82.

The publisher abstract expressly supports arbitrarily large positive and negative ratios under positive-definite strain energy, and discusses bounded strains for cubic materials. It does not expose the full derivation.

provenance.method: Publisher abstract and bibliographic/rights notice inspected. The publisher PDF request returned its minimal abstract page, so the full-text route was stopped.

records.title: Poisson's ratio in cubic materials
claim_notes: Proceedings of the Royal Society A 462 (2006), pp. 3385-3405. Inspected PDF SHA256: 0e4414108ad4bfaf90753497f201a55560be82b3923759657ba66f06566c96a6.
Checked pp. 3386-3388, 3394, 3398: Eqs. (2.1)-(2.3), (2.14), (3.19)-(3.20), (5.1). Its abstract says at least 25, but Eq. (5.1a) is strict: nu_min<-1 requires mu1/mu2>25, not equality.

provenance.method: Official university author PDF downloaded into audit-only cache; text and listed equation pages checked; DOI and copyright on first article page.

records.title: Extreme values of Poisson's ratio and other engineering moduli in anisotropic materials
claim_notes: Journal of Mechanics of Materials and Structures 1(4) (2006), pp. 793-812. Inspected PDF SHA256: 42db454aeb0ccc420b743a446d4946812a280c83577f9182c0af25adceb17fff.

Section 2, printed pp. 795-796 (PDF pp. 4-5), defines orthonormal loading/transverse directions, uniaxial stress and epsilon=S:sigma. Eq. (1) uses raw tensor shear s66=S1212 and G=1/(4*s66), not engineering shear compliance.

provenance.method: Publisher HTML citation metadata/rights notice and publisher PDF inspected. Cover says April 2006 while HTML citation_publication_date says 2006/08/01; only year 2006 is adopted.

records.title: Anisotropic Elastic Properties of Flexible Metal-Organic Frameworks: How Soft are Soft Porous Crystals?
claim_notes: Physical Review Letters 109, 195502 (2012), published 7 November 2012. Author-hosted published PDF SHA256 ba4160a2e2ce083e2cccf9233728f4d0475fb46dc7e47819e6c93b9a37a26b6e.
Printed 195502-2, Eqs. (2)-(3), visually checked: E(u)=1/(ui*uj*uk*ul*Sijkl) and beta(u)=ui*uj*Sijkk, with full compliance inverse and positive-definite stiffness discussed.
Printed 195502-4, left column, visually checked: cubic beta(u)=1/(C11+2*C12). Right-column final long paragraph limits tensor analysis to the elastic region around the relaxed structure.

Use only the cited formulas/local-elastic caveat. Do not import the paper’s material numbers, phase transitions, shear-modulus convention, or its unrelated wording calling the Hill scheme a geometric average.
No source theorem giving all-real beta/kappa range was found here; that theorem is an original project construction.

provenance.method: Official APS metadata/rights and author-hosted published PDF pages 2 and 4 visually inspected; no publisher access restriction bypassed.

records.title: Negative linear compressibility in common materials
claim_notes: Applied Physics Letters 106(23), article 231903 (2015). Crossref publisher-deposited metadata checked: DOI/title/authors/volume/issue/article number and date 2015-06-08.

Institutional author-manuscript p. 4, Eq. (1): beta_V=S11+S22+S33+2*(S12+S23+S31); adjoining text defines isothermal pressure-positive volume/length responses. Eq. (2) is explicitly orthorhombic/orthotropic.

Manuscript p. 5 distinguishes small-strain elasticity-based estimates from direct higher-pressure response. Source Poisson subscripts differ from this project; no subscript expression is copied without conversion.

The tool exposed manuscript text, but screenshot fetch failed and direct PDF download returned HTTP 403. No alternate route was used after that denial; no visual page verification or published-pagination equivalence is claimed.
No universal tensor-class normalized-range theorem or full-SPD proof is attributed to this source.

provenance.method: Institutional manuscript text through public web reader and canonical Crossref metadata; 403 respected, no CAPTCHA solved or mirror used.
